# Synthetic MSE blur fixture

Source: [generator](../../../scripts/make-mse-blur-fixture.mjs).

Generated from mathematical colors and shapes; no camera footage or external material. The repository license applies.

H.264 MPEG-TS, 640×360, 25 fps after the first 39 ms interval. Exact source PTS are 0, 0.039, 0.079, … seconds; the MSE MP4 remux quantizes these to its 57600 Hz clock.
